title: Organisations need to prove that their AI agents can shut down | The Strategist
paragraphs: Any organisation contemplating use of AI agents, especially any in national security or critical infrastructure, should give them no system access until sure that they will obey an order to stop.

This is called a stand-down drill, a test in which an organisation checks that an agent that’s been told to stand down can no longer access systems and is no longer doing anything. Moreover, it must be done when agents are working together as a team.
An agent that keeps working after it has been told to stop is a danger to any organisation that relies on it, and the danger only grows when they can work together.
